moglie.aspetto: a grotesque, deformed woman in her sixties: a squat, heavy body under a head too big for it, wild thin greying hair, a lumpy face with deep sagging folds, huge round bulging eyes of different sizes with tiny pupils and dark bags, a long crooked drooping nose, a thin too-wide mouth with a few long yellow teeth, long knotted bony fingers; in a shapeless beige knitted cardigan over a dark floral housedress

parti.occhi: Deep dark circles under tired, red-rimmed eyes, as after a sleepless night shift; the whites are clear: no fever, no sweat.
parti.bocca: Thin, tightly pressed lips and yellowed teeth; nothing unusual.

collo.inquadratura: the side of her neck and the skin behind her ear, her greying hair pulled back
collo.segni: Two thin red lines pressed into the skin behind the ear and across the cheek, like the marks left by the elastic straps of a protective face mask worn for many hours; no swelling, no lumps.

mani.inquadratura: both hands held out in front, backs up, from the wrists to the fingertips
mani.segni: Rough, chapped, reddened hands with cracked knuckles, as from strong disinfectant; on the back of the right hand a faded blue ink stamp: a small triangle with a number inside, like an entry stamp.

marito.aspetto: a grotesque, deformed old man in his seventies: a wasted, bony body with a huge, bald, lumpy skull, enormous bulging yellowish eyes, a monstrously long hooked nose, hollow cheeks and temples, a slack sunken mouth with a few rotten brown teeth, a long stringy neck, enormous knobbly hands with long spatulate fingers and bluish nails; in an old white vest under a green fleece blanket, the plastic tube of a nebulizer on his chest

parti.occhi: Watery, tired, red-rimmed old eyes; no fever, no sweat.

occhi_febbre.inquadratura: the eyes and the bridge of the nose, from the eyebrows to the cheekbones
occhi_febbre.segni: His eyes are glassy and bloodshot with high fever, the rims red and swollen, beads of sweat on his forehead and temples.

parti.bocca: His mouth hangs open as he struggles for breath, a few rotten teeth; on the lower lip a little thick grey phlegm, no blood.
parti.collo: A thin, wrinkled old neck with grey stubble, the tendons and veins straining with the effort of breathing; no swelling, no lumps.

collo_febbre.inquadratura: the side of the neck, from under the jaw to the collarbone
collo_febbre.segni: A thin, wrinkled old neck with grey stubble; under the jaw a hard, swollen lump the size of a walnut, red and shiny: a plague bubo just beginning.

mani.inquadratura: both hands resting on his knees, from the wrists to the fingertips
mani.segni: Huge, bony hands with thick, flat fingertips like spatulas and bluish nails, from lack of air; old white scars from quarry work.
